name: mtf-confluence-scorer
description: Scores multi-timeframe alignment and outputs confluence heat maps. Use this skill whenever the user asks about "multi-timeframe analysis", "MTF confluence", "timeframe alignment", "higher timeframe bias", "are timeframes aligned", "confluence score", "top-down analysis", "HTF/LTF alignment", "which timeframes agree", "heat map", or any question about whether multiple timeframes support the same directional bias. Works with mt5-chart-browser for data and trading-brain for trade decisions.
